title: Nigerians turn to faith healers as HIV aid dries up
desc: After US aid cuts disrupted free HIV treatment, some Nigerian patients turn to unproven ‘cures’.

title: What a record-breaking El Niño could mean for the world
desc: This year's El Niño is on track to be the strongest on record, threatening to unleash extreme weather across the globe and make 2027 the hottest recorded year by far.

title: China, Indonesia agree to boost military ties, work closer on minerals, energy and tech
desc: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has advocated maintaining Indonesia's "free and active" foreign policy of non-alignment, vowing to befriend all countries including China and the United States.

title: Arif-Roy King prove partnership worth keeping despite World Championships exit
desc: PETALING JAYA: Wan Arif Wan Junaidi-Yap Roy King may have bowed out in the third round of the World Championships in New Delhi, but their performances showed they are still a partnership worth keeping together.

title: Distinct pulmonary inflammatory endotypes identified in suspected severe pneumonia
desc: Three biologically distinct pulmonary endotypes have been identified among mechanically ventilated patients with suspected severe pneumonia.

title: All-Electric Mercedes-AMG E 63 Performance Sedan Spied at the Nürburgring
desc: Resuming track testing at the Nürburgring, the fully electric successor to the Mercedes-AMG E 63 ditches controversial EQ styling for a classic three-box silhouette, lightweight axial-flux motors, and up to 900 horsepower.

title: Elena Rybakina’s Heartbreaking Backstage Moment Emerges As She Opens Up About Injury Retirement in Cincinnati
desc: Elena Rybakina was forced to retire from her Cincinnati Open quarterfinal against defending champion Iga Świątek on Thursday after sustaining a left-foot injury. The Kazakhstani star appeared to hurt herself midway through a rally while serving at 1-4 in the opening set.

title: Bully who stuck his tongue out for mugshot after strangling woman is jailed
desc: Charlie Stefano, 35, stuck his tongue out for the camera as his mugshot was taken after he was arrested for assaulting a woman in Chatham.

title: Kenyan social innovator Wawira Njiru named 2026 German Africa Prize laureate
desc: Wawira Njiru will receive the award from the German Africa Foundation in Berlin on November 4
